name: pace
description: Track your own Codex allowance against a fixed weekly target, with a live local dashboard and saved history.

interface.longDescription:
Track your own Codex allowance with a clean local dashboard, reset-aligned Day/Week views, a fixed 100%-to-0% target, saved history, and an optional announced-reset planning override. Dotted lines show changes between observations across offline gaps; their exact timing is unknown.

Requires desktop execution, Node.js 22+ and Codex CLI signed in with ChatGPT. Start with “Start Orbit”. It checks usage every minute even with the dashboard closed. History survives restarts and is separated by account. Windows users can explicitly enable automatic startup at sign-in and background recovery with “Enable Orbit startup”, or remove it with “Disable Orbit startup”. Startup is off by default.

Usage stays on your computer. No cloud upload, phone synchronization or API billing. The computer must be awake and online for fresh readings. Tested on Windows; macOS/Linux not verified. Independent companion, not affiliated with OpenAI.
defaultPrompt: Start Orbit and show my weekly usage dashboard.
Am I on pace to use my weekly allowance?
